items.q: What should you remember about **Two peptide categories**?
items.a: **Known-receptor (GLP-1s) vs no-receptor/elusive-receptor (BPC, Russian peptides)** — determines predictability and regulatory path.

items.q: What should you remember about **BPC-157 animal data is striking but single-source**?
items.a: **Almost all from Croatian Sikiric group;** VEGF/angiogenesis is both healing mechanism and tumor-vascularization concern (no human cancer signal yet).

items.q: What should you remember about **Oral/rectal BPC may not go systemic**?
items.a: **Phase 1 enemas showed no** blood levels; injectable does; mechanism for distant MSK effects unclear.

items.q: What should you remember about **Legal/regulatory mess**?
items.a: **Category 1/2/3 compounding lists, PDA relabeling,** telehealth state-by-state, RFK "supplements not meds" ambiguity; physicians in uncomfortable liability position.

items.q: What should you remember about **All APIs Chinese**?
items.a: **Same raw material feeds** pharma, compounders, and gray market; difference is finishing/QC/sterility testing.

items.q: What should you remember about **Gray market is risky**?
items.a: **Batch-to-batch variance; wrong compound injected** (retatrutide → melanotan case); $5–10B US gray-market spend (2025 est.).

items.q: What should you remember about **Thymus shrinks at puberty**?
items.a: **Sex steroids drive involution; post-infection atrophy without** convalescence may accelerate aging diseases; thymic score on MRI (2026 Nature paper) predicts mortality.

items.q: What should you remember about **Pinealon ≠ pineal**?
items.a: **EDR tripeptide from cortex** extract; epithalon is the pineal one; naming confusion widespread.

items.q: What should you remember about **GH secretagogues trade-offs**?
items.a: **Youthful skin/sleep/recovery vs insulin resistance, prostate** growth (PSA), potential tumor promotion; cyclic use under monitoring may have role.

items.q: What should you remember about **GHK-Cu topical**?
items.a: **Real human aesthetic data when properly** formulated (blue from copper); injectable lacks human trials; pairs with red light.

items.q: What should you remember about **GLP-1s are necessary medicine**?
items.a: **System would collapse without obesity/diabetes** intervention; not a free lunch long-term; compounding markup ethics matter.
